rules.name: App Repackaging Detection
rules.description: Android and iOS specific attack detection: app repackaging, certificate pinning bypass, API tampering
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, AzureDiagnostics | where Message contains "mobile_security" or Message contains "" | summarize count(), make_set(SourceIP) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), ActivityDisplayName | where count_ > 3
